Container.Name: KilnDB
Container.Overview: Self-hosted MySQL and MariaDB control plane with a web console, Data API, Auth, Realtime, Functions, Storage, and native Unraid Tailscale integration.
Container.Requires: Unraid 7.2 or newer is required for native per-container Tailscale integration.

Config.Name: KilnDB Data
Config.Description: Persistent databases, metadata, encryption keys, snapshots, storage objects, functions, logs, and Tailscale state.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: KilnDB web console and API port.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to 1 when the console is served through HTTPS, including Tailscale Serve.
